title: Europa secures £89m green loan from HSBC UK - About HSBC | HSBC UK
description: Europa has secured an £89.1 million green loan from HSBC UK to finance two recently developed and stabilised UK logistics assets in prime locations along the M1 distribution corridor.

headings.text: Europa secures £89m green loan from HSBC UK

Developed in partnership with logistics developer Panattoni, the assets are occupied with long-term lettings agreed with strong occupiers from across the e-commerce, pharmaceutical and automotive sectors.

The first site, Panattoni Park South Normanton, is a 575,000 sq ft facility within an established logistics hub in the East Midlands. With quick access to the motorway network and key regional routes, it offers strong connectivity across the wider Midlands area, including Birmingham, Derby and Nottingham.

The second site, Panattoni Park Rotherham, comprises 710,000 sq ft of space and is positioned within the M1-M18 triangle. This strategic location provides excellent connectivity, with the park acting as a national distribution centre for the anchor occupier, as well as providing access to key northern markets such as Leeds and Manchester, and enabling last-mile delivery into the Sheffield region.

Both sites also boast strong sustainability credentials, including an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) Rating A and a BREEAM (Building Research Establishment Environmental Assessment Method) ‘Very Good’ certification, demonstrating their energy efficiency and environmental performance.

James Keast, Director at Europa Capital, said: “This financing underlines the sustained lender interest in well-located, high-quality UK logistics assets, particularly those with strong sustainability credentials. Securing this financing following the development and stabilisation of these assets is an endorsement of our strategy and reflects our long-standing relationship with HSBC UK. Together with HSBC UK, we have secured a facility that supports stable, long-term income while allowing us to maintain capital discipline.”

Alfie Banks, Relationship Director at HSBC UK, added: “We are pleased to have supported Europa with financing for these high-quality logistics assets. This funding demonstrates our commitment to backing ambitious real estate investors in the UK logistics sector. We have developed a strong relationship with Europa and look forward to building on this in the future.”

HSBC UK HSBC UK serves over 15 million active customers across the UK, supported by 23,800 colleagues. HSBC UK offers a complete range of retail banking and wealth management to personal and private banking customers, as well as commercial banking for small to medium businesses and large corporates. HSBC UK is a ring-fenced bank and wholly-owned subsidiary of HSBC Holdings plc.

HSBC Holdings plc HSBC Holdings plc, the parent company of HSBC, is headquartered in London. HSBC serves customers worldwide from offices in 56 countries and territories. With assets of US$3,306bn at 31 March 2026, HSBC is one of the world’s largest banking and financial services organisations.

About Europa Europa is one of the pioneers of pan-European real estate investment. With a trusted heritage of delivering, Europa is a specialist in the areas of core and non-core fund investing, as well as an experienced partner in co-investments, joint-ventures and separate accounts.

Extensive experience across multiple pan-European cycles enables us to face the future with courage, competently navigating both challenging and favourable markets to generate reliable returns, whilst protecting and growing clients’ capital on behalf of their beneficiaries.
Since its formation in 1999, Europa has raised 13 real estate equity and debt funds, and completed over 150 transactions totalling more than €12.5 billion across 21 European countries.

Europa is an affiliate business of Mitsubishi Estate Co. Ltd., one of the world’s largest real estate groups, which is also a strategic investor. Europa Capital LLP is authorised and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority.
